scope: Full package/row/cell review of four 2019 September-December monthly FPI workbooks; offline source evidence only

reader.implementation: Python stdlib zipfile, ElementTree streaming iterparse, Decimal precision80; no float arithmetic for numeric values or products; no workbook import, authoring or recalculation
reader.duplicate_method: SHA256 fingerprints used only internally for equality keys; evidence exposes bounded row locators not trade/investor identities. Counts are per workbook, not cross-workbook.

package_parts.semantic_review: All string runs resolved; raw identities omitted from evidence
Full-byte integrity checked; printer driver DEVMODE content is opaque and not interpreted as financial evidence

workbook_metadata.epoch_interpretation: 1900-system; serial1=1900-01-01, serial60 rejected as fictitious; serial>=61 adjusted for Excel leap-day convention
workbook_metadata.built_in_format_14_interpretation: Excel short date (locale-rendered); raw numeric serial used rather than displayed text
workbook_metadata.metadata_review: All XML parts parsed in full. Core/custom/application property text not republished to avoid incidental author/printer identity exposure; parts carry hashes and element/text counts. No sheet formulas or native objects are silently flattened.

isin_validation.normalization: trim then uppercase for format/checksum only; missing markers separate; not issuer/company/listing verification

rate_quantity_value_arithmetic.definition: residual = exact serialized RATE * QUANTITY - exact serialized VALUE (in Rs)

typed_lexical.method: All 19 resolved cell types, lexical values and style IDs; source coordinates excluded

decoded_lexical.method: All 19 decoded lexical scalar values, without type or style; no ordinal column exists

normalized.method: NFC + edge trimming; numeric cells canonicalized with Decimal, dates canonical ISO; text identifiers retain leading zeros/case; no codebook mappings

interpretation_limits: The raw stored 19-field transaction schema has no ordinal column in these four workbooks. These are historical transaction reports, not OHLCV, quarterly holdings, DII-only flows, current market signals, EPS or P/E.

All numeric sums/residuals use Decimal from raw XML lexical values. Rounding thresholds and half-quantum bounds are conditional diagnostics, not economic validation or an assertion that original source quotes used that precision. Excel general format and saved lexical precision do not establish original trade price/quantity precision.

Signed VALUE/RATE/QUANTITY values and zeroes are preserved, not treated automatically as errors. Codes are counted literally; no transaction/settlement/revision/exchange meaning is inferred in this offline audit. Root handles versioned official codebook mapping separately.

Dates use raw numeric serials and workbook date system/number formats; report-minus-trade lags are calendar days, not a verified exchange-session calendar or publication availability timestamp. Future/backdated/report-late rows must not leak into current or point-in-time signals.

Numeric identifier cells may already have lost leading zeros or precision before saving; this audit preserves observed cell type/lexeme and cannot recover original identity. Masked FII/subaccount/broker fields are not asserted to have stable cross-period identities.

Candidate key repeats may represent amendments/revisions or genuine separate records. They are diagnostics, not permission to deduplicate. Raw/normalized equality does not establish economic supersession.
ISIN format/checksum tests do not establish issuer identity, security class, listing membership or inclusion in the current NSE universe. Missing markers remain missing, not substituted.

Binary printerSettings parts were fully read and hashed but remain opaque device metadata. All native XML feature presence, hidden sheets/rows/columns, formulas/errors and relationships were checked structurally; no Excel rendering, recalculation or execution was performed.

No current provider access, API availability, importer, Mongo persistence, strategy activation, portfolio buy/sell prediction, deployment or live acceptance is established. No raw identities are published in this evidence.

validation.scope: Per-file row/cell/type/format/code/date/ISIN/numeric/duplicate accounting; exact Decimal sum identity; no raw identity frequency maps; each original archive SHA256 freshly rechecked after the full scan
validation.independent_reconciliation: Completed for these four archives: 448 shared-metric comparisons, zero mismatches; see the separately pinned independent_reconciliation object

independent_reconciliation.reader: Independent lxml streaming raw OOXML parser and exact serialized Decimal arithmetic
independent_reconciliation.scope: Own four archives only, compared to the root twelve-file 2019 replay; full archive/member/package pins and shared sheet metrics
method_limits: Root residual is VALUE minus RATE times QUANTITY; this evidence reverses that sign explicitly.
Root trim-only and primary NFC/numeric/date-normalized comparisons agree at zero repeats here; normalization definitions are not generally equivalent.
ISIN missing/marker classes are reconciled with the root combined syntax-invalid class; all counts are zero here.
